question: Should this PR wait for exact-head live Hetzner cleanup proof, or may the destructive-provider proof gate be waived for this security fix?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a code repair ClawSweeper can perform; it requires either real provider evidence for destructive cleanup behavior or explicit human security and compatibility acceptance.

options.title: Require exact-head Hetzner proof

options.title: Waive live provider proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the residual provider and compatibility risk without live canary output.

options.title: Broaden legacy compatibility first
options.body: If maintainers expect more legacy label shapes in the field, add a documented compatibility or migration path before landing.
